decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter draws directly on the firm's core curing and maturation know-how and is its flagship for the organic direction, so management can read its results well and refine it.
The premium sharing snack line builds on established salami expertise and gained a poultry variant in 2024, but it slipped from its own page to a mention, so it is kept and watched more closely.
Organic boiled pork sausage applies the firm's traditional Fleischwurst recipes to its strategic organic line, which makes the early sales results easy to interpret and act on.

Organic thinly sliced chicken breast extends the firm's slicing and poultry experience in a growing segment, and the multi-variant line gives management room to learn which flavours sell before deciding.
The organic herb-coated salami sits squarely within the firm's in-house seasoning and curing competence and fits the organic expansion, so it deserves time to establish itself.
